title: Analytical Size-Exclusion Chromatography of ATG2A–WIPI4 Complex
author: Justyna Sawa-Makarska
materials: Analyze collected fractions by Western blot . Detect ATG2A ( anti-ATG2A Proteintech Catalog #23226-1-AP (RRID: AB_2879235) ) and HIS-tagged WIPI4 ( anti-HIS Qiagen Catalog #34660 (RRID: AB_2619735) ) using specific antibodies.

steps.title: Prepare protein samples
steps.instruction: Make a mixture containing 4 µM ATG2A and 4.8 µM WIPI4 in SEC buffer to a total volume of 50 µL. Also prepare separate control samples of ATG2A alone and WIPI4 alone at the same concentrations (4 µM ATG2A or 4.8 µM WIPI4) and the same final volume (50 µL) in SEC buffer.

steps.title: Incubate mixture on ice
steps.instruction: Place the ATG2A‑WIPI4 mixture on ice for 02:00:00 (2 hours) to allow complex formation.

steps.title: Inject sample onto SEC column
steps.instruction: Inject 50 µL of the incubated mixture or each control sample onto a pre‑equilibrated Superose 6 Increase 3.2/300 column (Cytiva, Cat# 29091598) that has been equilibrated with SEC buffer.

steps.title: Collect fractions and record chromatogram
steps.instruction: Collect 100 µL fractions throughout the elution and record the chromatogram for later comparison between the mixture and the control runs.
